column1: Connector X12 pins 3 and 5 swapped on engine harness, customer EOL electrical test failed, line stopped 25 minutes.
Terminal backed out of rear lamp connector when the operator plugged it in at the customer assembly line.
Crimp height too low on ground terminal, wire pulled out with low force during customer audit pull test.
Missing fuse box clip on cockpit harness, 12 harnesses affected in the last delivery.
Insulation damaged near the door grommet, copper visible, detected at customer incoming inspection.
Label shows part number revision B, drawing is revision C. Function OK.
Branch to ABS sensor 40 mm too short, operator had to pull the harness to reach the sensor.
Wrong color wire (blue instead of blue/white) at connector X7 cavity 9, airbag warning light on.
Two terminals in connector X30 not locked, secondary lock open, intermittent airbag warning in vehicle.
Box received with 48 harnesses instead of 50, packaging label quantity says 50.
Crimp barrel cracked on 0.35 mm2 terminal, found during customer cross-section analysis.
Tape wrapping loose on main trunk, harness rubbing on body edge, insulation worn.
Connector X5 cavity 2 empty, wire missing, customer EOL test failed.
Terminal not fully seated in connector X44, contact intermittent during vibration test.
Harness delivered in wet box, corrosion on terminals of connector X2.
Wrong connector housing color (black instead of grey) on seat harness, mistake-proofing at customer rejected it.
Splice not covered by heat-shrink tube, bare splice found during vehicle teardown.
Wire pinched under clip at trunk area, short circuit to ground during customer test.
